fitted_bad_data_detector: Exact submitted ZIP; no retraining or threshold selection from RAW
missing_detector: Current DATA_PRESENT flag and finite-value mask for all 14 received measurement fields at each PMU
missing_publication: Emit current mask changes immediately; a nonempty source set opens an integrity episode, empty closes it, and a changed nonempty set supersedes the prior diagnosis
bad_data_publication: One diagnosis of the just-completed 30s observation interval at the actual final report time; never retroactively broadcast it as an online decision or assume it stays active afterwards
composition: Physical event/source, missing PMU sources and corrupt PMU sources remain separate. Simultaneous missingness and corruption cannot overwrite one another.
input_boundary: Only cleaned measurement files and sealed observation-only legacy predictions; never Event/Location annotations
intent_claim: Data availability or corruption does not establish malicious cyber intent
raw_status: Retrospective integration/evaluation, not independent or official competition validation
version_note: The completed exact-legacy replay used archived adapter schema V1. V2 recomposes the same sealed event/location predictions with independently measured missing masks, preserving all old files.
